body.statement: For the fixed origin constraint, the Brownian--GCM likelihood-ratio functional \(D(0)\) in \(\texttt{def:canonical-field}\) is a finite nonnegative random variable almost surely.

source.locator: Section 2, definition of the limiting likelihood-ratio functional and the fixed-location limit theorem

attestation.note: The source is used only for existence and finiteness of its fixed-location Brownian--GCM likelihood-ratio random variable; no growing-domain or excursion assertion is attributed to it. A stable DOI is supplied because no verbatim transcription was included in the immutable core.
